room.name: The Last Light
room.hint: No one crosses the light; your doors do. A door keeps your speed and turns it: fall into one to rise out of another, dash into a wall to rise from a floor. Crumbling stone gives no grace.

bank.author: Claude
bank.role: Sunspire Core: pass every wall of light through your own doors
bank.solution: Place each pair of doors where your speed will be turned the way you need: falls into rises, dashes into rises, loops into launches.
bank.coreDescription: The light cannot be crossed. The door can.
bank.humanReview: Native whole route and all six fresh checkpoint sections verified. Awaiting player review.
